text.p: Autoways Holdings Bhd said on Friday it has undertaken an internal restructuring to streamline its operations "for future expansion".
In a statement, it said all companies involved in the principal activities of construction and engineering will be grouped under its wholly-owned unit, Autoways Construction Sdn Bhd.
It said all companies engaged in manufacturing, retreading and trading of tyres will be grouped under its wholly-owned unit Autoways (Malaya) Sdn Bhd.

Under the restructuring, Autoways will divest all its shareholding in the companies involved in manufacturing and construction to Autoways Malaya and Autoways Construction for a total of 2.74 million ringgit and four ringgit, respectively.
Both the subsidiaries satisfied the price by the allotment to Autoways of 2.74 million and four ordinary shares of 1.00 ringgit each in their respective share capital.
The restructuring was approved by Autoways' board of directors and will not have any material impact on the company's earnings, paid-up capital and net tangible assets.
Autoways said the restructuring also does not require approvals from the authorities.
It said the restructuring will result in a "more focused" group and will help strategic alliances in targeted business areas.
